full_pass.scope: One finite current-frame iteration, one process, no DataLoader workers, incomplete final batch retained.
full_pass.projection_formula: (consumer time to batch 125 + (source anchors - 1,000) / observed anchors per second) / 86,400
full_pass.projection_assumption: The measured CPU consumer delivery rate holds through this snapshot. No model steps are timed.
full_pass.minimum_projection_window: After batch 125 through two audited pool refills and at least 125 further full batches.
full_pass.repeating_trainer_fixture: Four workers delivered 79 unique anchors in the first 86 consumed samples. See correctness/README.md.
